## 1. Who he is

Christian Kwabena Asante is a software engineer and full-stack web developer
based in Ghana. Online he goes by the username **Tiankay999** — this handle is
used consistently across GitHub, LinkedIn and his email address, and is the name
many clients and collaborators know him by.

He describes himself as a passionate software developer who believes great ideas
deserve exceptional execution. His work spans POS systems for businesses,
e-commerce platforms, online study platforms and AI-powered text processing
utilities. His stated approach is to blend clean, modern aesthetics with
performance-driven functionality — designing intuitive interfaces with React,
Next.js and Tailwind CSS, and architecting robust backends with Node.js, Java,
MySQL and MongoDB/PostgreSQL.

Alongside client work he builds his own products, including QuestionsDey, and
runs STEEZE TECH, a tech branding platform on TikTok and YouTube where he shares
industry insights.

**Positioning statement:** "I engineer digital experiences with precision."
**Tagline:** "Your Vision, My Engineering."

## 3. Services in detail

### 3.1 End-to-End Web Engineering
Bespoke web applications with maintainable architecture, fine-tuned data layers
and fluid third-party integrations — dependability and growth capacity at every
tier.

- **Server-Side Development** — REST/GraphQL endpoints, microservices, identity
  and access management
- **UI Engineering** — Next.js, React, Vue, TypeScript, immersive UI/UX
- **Data Architecture** — SQL/NoSQL tuning, resilient and scalable schemas

### 3.2 Online Stores & SaaS Platforms
From recurring billing pipelines to isolated tenant environments, built for high
throughput and frictionless day-to-day management at any scale.

- **Multi-Tenant Systems** — permission layers, tenant boundaries, elastic
  business logic
- **Billing & Payment Flows** — Paystack, Stripe, PayPal, regional gateways,
  subscription lifecycles
- **Control Panels & Workflow Automation** — reporting, data management, process
  orchestration

### 3.3 API Development & Connectivity
Endpoints designed from scratch or external platforms wired up — crafted for
transparency, robustness and sustainable long-term evolution.

- **Tailored API Engineering** — REST, GraphQL, layered modular design
- **Platform Integrations** — payment processors, identity providers, external
  services
- **Security & Access Control** — JWT, OAuth 2.0, request validation, throttling

### 3.4 Speed Tuning & Code Modernization
Targeted code modernization and in-depth performance reviews so applications run
leaner, crash less and scale smoothly — without breaking what already works.

- **Legacy Code Overhaul** — architecture cleanup, reusable component patterns,
  industry standards
- **Performance Deep-Dives** — Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse scoring, paint and
  rendering profiling
- **Caching & Query Tuning** — database query optimization, API response caching,
  render efficiency

### 3.5 Artificial Intelligence Integration & Development
Embedding LLMs into existing products and building AI-native features from
scratch — bridging cutting-edge models and real-world applications.

- **LLM & Generative AI Integration** — OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude
  APIs, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines
- **Intelligent Feature Development** — AI chatbots, smart search, content
  generation, recommendation engines
- **ML Pipeline & Data Processing** — model fine-tuning, vector databases,
  embeddings, AI workflow automation

## 4. Technology stack

- **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Vue, Tailwind CSS,
  Redux Toolkit, Framer Motion, GSAP, Material UI
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express.js, Laravel, PHP, Python, Java
- **Databases:** MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
- **API & auth:** REST, GraphQL, microservices, JWT, OAuth 2.0
- **Payments:** Paystack, Stripe, PayPal, SSL Commerz, Mobile Money
- **AI/ML:** OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, prompt engineering, RAG,
  vector databases, embeddings
- **E-commerce:** Shopify, WooCommerce, custom storefronts, POS
- **DevOps & hosting:** AWS, Vercel, Railway, Docker, VPS, PM2
- **Quality:** Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse, technical SEO

## 5. Project portfolio

### QuestionsDey — Online Study & Q&A Platform
https://questiondey.com/
An application for academic discussions and Q&A, with a modern, fast and
customizable user interface and artificial intelligence integration.
*Stack:* Next.js, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, OpenAI LLM, SSL Commerz.
*Note:* One of Christian's own products, not client work.

### Selseve — Find Trusted Artisans Near You
https://selseve.com/
A platform that connects people with trusted artisans near them, with a modern,
fast and customizable interface and AI integration.
*Stack:* Next.js, Paystack, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.

### Qrollix — QR Code Attendance System
https://qrollix.com/
A QR-code based attendance and verification platform with device fingerprinting.
*Stack:* Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, FingerprintJS.

### MinaGlitzy — Cosmetics E-commerce Store
https://minaglitz.com/
An online shop featuring cosmetics and accessories with special offers.
*Stack:* Next.js, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, Paystack.

### Treatos BD — Pet Shop with POS System
https://treatosbd.com/
A pet shop e-commerce store with an integrated point-of-sale system.
*Stack:* React, Laravel, PostgreSQL, Material UI, SSL Commerz.

### NkayData — Data Reselling Platform
https://nkaydata.com/
A platform for buying and selling mobile data bundles and airtime.
*Stack:* Next.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, Paystack.

### Steeze Track — Import and Export Management System
A management system for import and export logistics operations.
*Stack:* Next.js, Express.js, MySQL, Tailwind CSS, Paystack.

### Steeze Humanizer — AI Content Writing Assistant
https://steezehumanizer.com/
An AI-powered content writing and text humanizing assistant.
*Stack:* Next.js, Express.js, MySQL, Tailwind CSS, Paystack.
*Note:* One of Christian's own products.
